title: Photosystem I-independent oxygenic photosynthesis in cyanobacteria
snippet: Ludwiczak et al. show that cyanobacteria can grow and fix carbon dioxide through oxygenic photosynthesis without Photosystem I. Adaptive mutations enable an alternative electron transport pathway that replaces this previously essential complex.
